description: Get a download link for a version's file, to work on it locally. Pass a version id (an upload's asset_id / version_id) or an asset id (its current version); a folder id is refused. A video gives its ORIGINAL uploaded file, exactly as uploaded: Flask keeps it 30 days from upload (available_until), after which it is gone for good and this says it expired (the video still plays in Flask). An image gives its stored file, kept for good. Download with curl -fsSL -o <filename> '<download_url>': the link needs no token and a video's works for one hour (call again for a fresh one). Needs view access to the asset. A link has no file; a live (code) version's source zip is one of its files, read with version_notes_get. Returns asset_id (the asset), version_id (the version downloaded), url, version_url, kind (video or image), filename, size (bytes, videos), download_url and available_until (null for images).

asset_id.description: Version id (from an upload or contents) or asset id (its current version)

name: version_download
title: Download a version's file
